ios.desc:
Want to have a personal DJ? Try Offtrack for FREE. Mix the best part of your songs with smooth transitions on Spotify Premium, Apple Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud Free & local MP3s.

People skip half of the songs they play, like more than 500,000,000,000 songs every year. Why? Because songs are too long, shuffle ruins the vibe, and you listen to the same playlist over and over again.

Listen seamlessly with your AI DJ. Shorten your songs with smooth transitions so that your music will come to life.

The party doesn’t stop between tracks so why should the music? Offtrack picks the best fade-in and fade-out points, then seamlessly transitions automatically between tracks. Since most songs are too long, Offtrack plays the best 25-50% of a song as a highlight. Swipe to the queue page and you’ll see that the song order has already been optimized for you. There’s a surprise waiting for you every time you Smart Mix® with unique transitions and refreshing song mashups.

Making a mix with your own music has never been easier. Simply sync with your streaming service, press Smart Mix® and vibe out to your personal mix. Offtrack works with Spotify Premium, SoundCloud Free, TIDAL, Apple Music or your local library, and on Apple CarPlay.

So relax and enjoy your seamless mix while barely lifting a finger. Let your AI DJ take care of the music.

Offtrack Integrations
• Spotify Premium: Partial catalogue with ~80% of songs in popular playlists
• Apple Music: Partial catalogue with ~80% of songs in popular playlists
• TIDAL HiFi: Full catalogue of 100 Millions of HiFi tracks
• SoundCloud Free: Mix with 200 million tracks with your SoundCloud Free account (Go+ tracks currently unavailable)
• Local Music Library: Mix and beat-match local tracks
• iPhone/iPad/Macs with M chips
• Apple CarPlay

Offtrack is the only fully automatic DJ app today that works with both Spotify Premium and Apple Music with limited number of tracks. We recommend that you switch to TIDAL HiFi if having the full music catalogue is important for you.

The optional Offtrack Pro subscription allows you to subscribe once and use Offtrack Pro across your Mac and iOS devices to gain access to all Offtrack Pro features. You can cancel anytime – there is no cancellation fee.

Please check our FAQ page www.offtrack.com/faq for more information, or contact support@offtrack.com for support.
